# Parse and reference verification (generated by `python -m oa_rlaif.data.parse_verify`)

**Ontologies** are cross-parsed with the OWL API (Java) and compared with our parser; ELK checks consistency for files < 300 MB. **References** get the Beisswanger & Hahn (2012) quality checks (doi:10.1186/2041-1480-3-S1-S4) plus format, relation and measure validity.

Ontology files: 366 — match: 364, mismatch: 2
Reference files: 1286 — fail: 4, ok: 1261, warn: 21
